titles.romaji: Juusenki L-Gaim I: Pentagona Window + Lady Gablae
titles.native: 重戦機エルガイムI ペンタゴナ ウインドゥ+レディ ギャブレー

description: A recap OVA that portrays the first half of the series Heavy Metal L-Gaim. After the credits, there is a short clip animated for the OVA entitled "Lady Gyabure", which is intended to be comic relief.
